reason: A plate of kaphrao on the street is 50 baht and done in two minutes, so I only cook when I have time, and when I do my mum already sends me recipes on LINE. I might try the free dishes once, but I wouldn't pre-pay 99 baht for a pack that isn't even out yet.
objection: I can watch a free YouTube video or ask my mum for tom yum and pad see ew, so why pay for recipes, and why pay now for something I can't use until later?
would_change_my_mind: If I used the free dishes a few times and the 'it didn't work' help actually saved a dish my mum's recipe didn't, then I'd pay once the pack is out, not as a pre-order.
